# Town of Guildhall municipal roster backfill -- Vermont
# municipal fan-out batch 10; issue #163 (VT master tracking).

sources.note: Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, 'Vermont Selectboard Members' directory (updated June 5, 2026): lists Guildhall's three selectboard members as Gary Brown (Chair), John Orlowski (Vice-Chair), and Jason Sterling.
Town of Guildhall select board page (guildhallvt.org): the town's selectboard page names the same three.
Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, 'Guide to Vermont's Town Clerks, Treasurers, & County Clerks' (January 2026): lists George Blakeslee as Guildhall town clerk.
Town of Guildhall town clerk page (guildhallvt.org): the town's clerk page names George Blakeslee as Town Clerk with a term running to 2028.
Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, 'Guide to Vermont's Town Clerks, Treasurers, & County Clerks' (January 2026): lists George Blakeslee as Guildhall town treasurer.

Town of Guildhall town treasurer page (guildhallvt.org): the town's treasurer page names George Blakeslee as Town Treasurer with a term running to 2028; the treasurer also acts as the town's tax collector, so no separate delinquent-tax-collector post is created.

17 V.S.A. section 2646 (official text, Vermont General Assembly) provides for the election of a moderator at annual town meeting. Structure only: no official source publishes the current holder; the seat is left unfilled rather than guessed.
Town of Guildhall auditors page (guildhallvt.org): the town's auditors page names Ed Clark (term to 2029), Kelly McLain (to 2027), and Bill Ghelli (to 2028).

Town of Guildhall lister board page (guildhallvt.org): the town's lister page names George Blakeslee (to 2027), Eileen Thietten (to 2028), and Patricia Brown (to 2029; the page's 'Patrica' is corrected to the form the town's cemetery page prints).
Town of Guildhall cemetery commission page (guildhallvt.org): the town's cemetery page names Gary Brown (to 2028), Patricia Brown (to 2029), and Rich Schiller (to 2027).

Town of Guildhall road commission page (guildhallvt.org): the town's road commission page names Gary Brown as Road Commissioner. The page does not state the mode of selection; the office is a town office under 17 V.S.A. section 2646 and the holder is recorded as elected.

17 V.S.A. section 2646 (official text, Vermont General Assembly) provides for the election of a grand juror at annual town meeting. Structure only: no official source publishes the current holder; the seat is left unfilled rather than guessed.

17 V.S.A. section 2646 (official text, Vermont General Assembly) provides for the election of a town agent at annual town meeting. Structure only: no official source publishes the current holder; the seat is left unfilled rather than guessed.

17 V.S.A. section 2646 (official text, Vermont General Assembly) provides for the election of trustees of public funds at annual town meeting. Structure only: no official source publishes the current holder; the seat is left unfilled rather than guessed.
Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, '2025-2026 Vermont Justices of the Peace' listing (updated December 4, 2025): lists five justices of the peace for Guildhall.
